in_sanskrit.name: Alp
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Rare and Exalted
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Alp एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Alp is a rare and exalted name in Sanskrit mythology, derived from the term 'alpa' meaning 'rare' or 'small'. This name is associated with the revered sage Alparnatha, who is considered a symbol of knowledge, wisdom, and strength.

This name is associated with the revered sage Alparnatha, who is considered a symbol of knowledge, wisdom, and strength.
